result.reason: The affiliate-and-contractor extension is substantively appropriate, but the full playbook position is not achieved. Section 2.2 is fully paid-up and perpetual but not irrevocable, and Section 14.1 still requires consent for an M&A assignment involving a direct competitor, so transfer to every M&A successor is not assured. The added Section 2.10 geographical-expansion provision is unrelated to the licence-grant rule and materially expands commercial rights, making the redline non-minimal and failing to preserve unrelated intent. The new Section 2.11 is otherwise professionally drafted, although its placement after Section 14.1 is disordered.
